descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity: Product Marketing at Grafana Labs lives in the Product org, not the Marketing org, and we think differently about the job. As Grafana's offering shifts from dashboards to observability agents, our team closes the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. We build clear, consistent positioning, run marketing campaigns that attract new customers, and create content that helps engineering teams see why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them. Rather than only executing launches and campaigns, we teach Grafana’s product managers and engineers how to think about growth and demand. We also codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone at Grafana can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks. The Operations Manager keeps the Product Marketing system running and makes it better. You'll track how our work performs and report on it to the team every week, experiment with new AI workflows, and maintain the collateral and tools the team and the field depend on, so the sales team is fully supported in positioning our products. You'll work closely with the team's software engineers: you test ideas like sales deck generators or tools for competitive analysis, script prototypes, and define what good output looks like, and they turn the best ideas into production tools. You'll also coordinate with the field, Enablement, and Marketing so we understand each other's goals and make progress on shared initiatives. For this role you don't need to be a product marketer but you should have experience working inside a Product or Marketing organization for a software company. Since we don’t have an operations manager yet, you’ll also help to shape your own role. You should arrive with a desire to find and solve imperfectly-defined problems. What You'll Be Doing: Projects and Cross-Functional Initiatives : Drive cross-functional initiatives that align with product marketing strategies across GTM, Product, and Marketing teams. Own follow-ups, task tracking, and on-time completion. Cross-Team Coordination : Coordinate with the field, Enablement, and Marketing teams so we understand each other's goals and priorities. Track shared initiatives, and coordinate enablement activities with the Enablement team. Analytics and Reporting : Track the product marketing team's key metrics, such as how our content, enablement sessions, and launches perform and who uses them. Interpret and report on them to the team every week. AI Experimentation and Prototyping : Try out new AI workflows and tools, using AI to write scripts and checking that they work. Decide what good output looks like and codify that judgment in evaluations, working alongside the software engineers on our team as they refine and deploy tools. Hand the most promising prototypes to engineers to make production-ready. For example, you might test a deck generator with sellers, write evals for it, and communicate about it internally. Collateral Management : Maintain the team's most important collateral, including core decks, positioning content, and enablement sessions. Keep it accurate and current, share it widely, and make sure sellers know where to find it and how to use it. Knowledge Base Stewardship : Help keep our shared product knowledge base complete and current. Spot missing or stale information, chase down the owners, and improve the processes that keep it up to date. What Makes You a Great Fit: 2+ years in an operations, analytics, enablement, or technical support role within a Product or Marketing organization for a software company. Strong analytical judgment: you use AI and other tools to pull data, check the results instead of taking them at face value, and turn the numbers into clear recommendations Proficiency with AI agents, including building skills and automated workflows that more than one person uses Good judgment about what makes AI output good, and the ability to codify that judgment in evaluations Ability to quickly understand our products and describe their value: what SREs and platform engineers do, and how observability products help them Ability to build dashboards and pages in Grafana, or to learn quickly Strong project management and organizational skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including presenting data to a team Bonus Points For: Strong bias to action: you build, test, and ship instead of waiting for permission Able to manage multiple projects and priorities at once Adaptable, flexible, a

descriptionAr: About the Team The Transformation team at OpenAI partners with Finance, Infrastructure, Data, and Engineering to design and scale the business processes and systems that support our growth. Our work combines process design, systems thinking, and operational change to turn fragmented workflows into reliable, repeatable, and well-controlled operations. We work as embedded partners to Finance, Accounting, and Operations, shaping priorities and delivering improvements across core business processes. For compute, our focus is an accurate, connected view of contractual obligations, delivered capacity, usage, and cost that supports sound decisions and repeatable financial operations. About the Role As Program Manager, Compute Transformation, you will lead cross-functional initiatives that connect purchasing, operations, billing, accounting, and financial planning across our compute commitments and our data center initiatives. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership of problem definition, process design, integrated planning, and end-to-end delivery. You will work across Compute Finance, Infrastructure Accounting, Capacity Planning, Fleet, Design & Construction, Operations, Procurement, Legal, Data, and Engineering. You will turn ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, drive decisions and dependencies, and deliver reliable processes and systems that make compute and infra spend easier to understand, forecast, reconcile, and control. This role is based in San Francisco, CA, with a hybrid work model of 3 days per week in the office. In this role, you will: Own an integrated compute and infra transformation plan: workstreams, milestones, critical dependencies, resources, decision logs, and acceptance criteria. Drive execution from problem definition through production adoption. Map current workflows and design scalable processes from demand planning, contracting, delivery & acceptance, receiving & operations, invoicing, payment, and month-end close. Clarify ownership, handoffs, evidence, and exception paths. Enable source of truth systems that cover both operational needs and accounting / finance needs for data center construction, operations, and maintenance. Drive consistent tracking of contracts, tranches, delivery events, and capacity acceptance. Connect committed spend to provisioned, accepted, allocated, and used capacity to support forecasting and financial review. Coordinate reliable ingestion and normalization of cloud service provider usage, billing, invoice, and delivery data. Establish data owners, completeness checks, and traceability to financial outputs. Improve compute billing, accrual, and allocation processes through consistent pricing rules, SKU mappings, telemetry and organizational tags, reconciliations, and controlled handling of manual adjustments. Partner with application, AI, and data engineers to translate requirements into integrations and automation across contract, procurement, compute data, and finance platforms, with monitoring and governed change controls. Align Infrastructure, Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Legal, and Engineering on decisions and dependencies. Manage scope, risks, vendor dependencies, and change requests; escalate with clear options and business impact. Lead end-to-end testing, UAT, rollout, training, and handoff to operational owners. Define success measures for traceability, data quality, manual effort, exception resolution, close readiness, and adoption. You might thrive in this role if you have: 8+ years of experience in project or program management, finance transformation, infrastructure operations, or enterprise systems delivery in complex, scaled environments. Understanding of compute or infrastructure economics and related finance processes, including commitments, usage-based billing, procurement, accruals, cost allocation, and forecasting. Experience partnering with software and data engineers to define requirements, resolve tradeoffs, test solutions, and deliver changes into production without direct authority. A strong process mindset and the ability to connect contractual terms, operational events, financial data, and control requirements into a practical future-state design. Fluency in data dependencies, system integrations, reconciliation, and data quality. Comfort working with analytical teams and tools such as SQL, Databricks, and BI platforms. Experience improving workflows through automation or AI, with appropriate human review, controls, exception handling, and operational ownership. Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive updates that explain decisions, risks, business impact, and specific actions needed. Experience driving complex initiatives through ambiguity and organizational change, with clear evidence of hands-on delivery and adoption. Cloud FinOps, infrastructure finance, or capacity-planning experience is a strong plus. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. descriptionAr: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts. We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager in Europe to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it. Location & work mode Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe, with London preferred. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings. What you’ll do Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners What we’re looking for 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run Willingness to travel often, including evenings What we offer We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect: Competitive salary and equity Employee-friendly equity terms Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday Paid co-working space or desk Health coverage (based on country requirements) 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays 4 months paid parental leave Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter Regular team events and off-sites Remote-first with no required commute Learn how we think and work A story about our mission: Read Me How we work: Designing remote work at Linear Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear A video series: Conversations on Quality Read about our recent Series C Fundraise and Giving our team liquidity A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @ linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers . We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app . Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role Ramp is seeking a Federal Account Executive to drive our expansion across the U.S. federal government. This is a senior individual contributor role where you will own mission-critical federal opportunities, navigate complex procurement processes, and act as a trusted advisor to senior government stakeholders. You’ll combine your deep understanding of federal acquisition lifecycles, compliance frameworks, and contracting vehicles with Ramp’s value proposition to deliver transformative outcomes for agencies. You will play a key role in shaping Ramp’s GTM strategy in this federal space. Near-Term Goals Federal Growth Plan Execution – Take ownership of Ramp’s federal pipeline and drive near-term wins with key agencies. Complex Deal Leadership – Lead complex sales cycles end-to-end, from initial engagement through procurement and award. Market Insight Contribution – Provide real-time feedback from federal engagements to shape Ramp’s GTM positioning, compliance roadmap, and partner strategy. What You'll Do Own and manage Ramp’s largest and most strategic federal opportunities. Build and sustain senior-level relationships with agency executives, program managers, procurement officers, and contracting officials. Navigate complex federal procurement lifecycles Partner with federal system integrators, resellers, and channel partners to expand Ramp’s reach and accelerate adoption. Act as a federal SME within Ramp’s sales team — helping refine playbooks, messaging, and deal strategies. Collaborate with internal teams (product, marketing, compliance, legal) to align Ramp’s offerings with federal requirements. Consistently exceed quota and growth targets, demonstrating expertise in managing long, complex deal cycles. Represent Ramp in federal forums, conferences, and agency briefings as a credible subject matter expert. What You Need 10-15 years of quota-carrying sales experience with a consistent track record of exceeding goals. Extensive experience selling into federal agencies with a proven ability to close complex, high-value deals. Deep knowledge of federal procurement processes, compliance frameworks, and contracting vehicles. Strategic, data-driven thinker capable of navigating ambiguity while delivering results. Experience in SaaS or high-growth technology environments preferred. Entrepreneurial drive and a self-starter mindset, thriving in a fast-paced, high-responsibility IC role. Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global) Flexible PTO Centralized home-office equipment ordering Health and wellness stipend Budget for intra-office travel Weekly coffee stipend United States 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents One Medical annual membership 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay Pet insurance In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed) Canada Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life Life, AD&D, and disability coverage Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime) Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP) Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health United Kingdom Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay Referral Instructions If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf. Other notices Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. descriptionAr: About the Team We are building AI systems that help people tackle complex, consequential work in the legal industry. Law demands careful reasoning, precise language, and sound judgment: understanding the facts, identifying the right questions, weighing competing interpretations, and helping clients decide what to do next. We see an opportunity for AI to help legal professionals work with greater rigor and focus more of their time on the problems that matter most. Our team works across Research, Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market to build AI capabilities and products for legal work. Our customers include the top law firms in the world as well as in-house legal departments of some of the largest businesses in the world. We translate the realities of practice into evaluations, training signals, and useful tools, with the ambition of making AI a trusted part of how lawyers research, analyze, draft, and advise. About the Role We are looking for a Subject Matter Expert in Law who brings the judgment and practical experience developed in a law firm to shaping the next generation of AI. You will help define what excellent legal work looks like, test where our models meet that standard, and turn your findings into better model behavior and product experiences. This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of legal practice and AI development. You will work directly with legal materials, model outputs, evaluation rubrics, and product prototypes. Your expertise will help us tackle some of the hardest questions in legal AI, including how to assess reasoning when there is no single correct answer. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In This Role, You Will: Define the quality bar for what top-notch legal work looks like, drawing on real matters and the standards lawyers apply to research, analysis, drafting, document review, and client advice. Design challenging, realistic AI model evaluations with representative facts, source materials, constraints, and deliverables, including cases that test ambiguity, competing arguments, and professional judgment. Create and review reference work such as research memoranda, contract analyses, redlines, diligence findings, and draft legal documents that demonstrate strong reasoning and practical usefulness. Develop rubrics that assess legal accuracy, issue spotting, factual grounding, citation validity, jurisdictional context, and the appropriate treatment of uncertainty. Evaluate model outputs and complete legal workflows, identify recurring failures, and give researchers and engineers specific, actionable feedback supported by examples and corrected work. Partner with Research on datasets, grading methods, and training tasks or environments that strengthen legal reasoning. Test whether model changes address the underlying problems and improve performance on new cases. Work with Product and Engineering to identify valuable use cases, prototype workflows, and translate lessons from evaluations into experiences that fit how lawyers actually work. Collaborate with legal professionals and design partners to refine our standards and test usefulness in practice, applying sound judgment around confidentiality, privilege, data permissions, and professional responsibility. You Might Thrive in This Role If You: Have practiced law at a law firm, with substantial experience producing and reviewing work for real client matters. We care more about demonstrated judgment and quality of work matter over title or firm pedigree. Bring deep expertise in one or more practice areas, such as commercial transactions, corporate law, litigation, or regulatory work, and curiosity about workflows beyond your specialty. Are an excellent legal researcher and writer who can assess authorities, distinguish strong arguments from plausible ones, and explain how facts and context affect a conclusion. Can make expert judgment explicit: explain why an answer is incomplete, a clause creates risk, or an analysis misses the central issue, and describe what better work would look like. Enjoy working directly with AI tools, exploring their limits, and testing ideas systematically. You can collaborate closely with technical teams and communicate clearly across disciplines. Take ownership in ambiguous settings and are willing to build the first version of an evaluation, reference document, rubric, or workflow, then improve it through feedback. Care deeply about the quality and consequences of legal work, and are motivated by the opportunity to help shape how AI supports the profession. Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have: Experience designing evaluations, benchmarks, datasets, or review frameworks for legal work or frontier AI systems. A track record of improving legal workflows through technology, knowledge management, automation, or new ways of working. Experience training or supervising lawyers, developing practice guidance, or translating complex legal concepts for different audiences. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. Its availability, performance, and reliability directly affect our users' ability to work with ClickHouse. The team is responsible for building, operating, and continuously improving this experience. We're looking for a Documentation Engineering Manager to lead this work. This is a hands-on player-coach role for someone who can lead a small, highly technical team while contributing directly to both technical documentation and the engineering of the documentation website and its supporting infrastructure. Research, develop, and write technical documentation directly, including independently understanding product functionality through source code, experimentation, testing, and collaboration with Engineering and Product, rather than relying on others to provide initial drafts. Define and execute documentation strategy in partnership with Engineering, Product, Product Marketing, Learning, Support, Growth, and the open-source community. Improve docs-as-code contribution workflows so that engineers, product managers, the Docs team, and external contributors can create and maintain excellent documentation efficiently. Review documentation pull requests, triage issues, unblock contributors, and directly author or substantially improve high-impact content. Build and maintain the documentation site's infrastructure, publishing systems, automation, CI workflows, monitoring, and quality checks. Establish organization-wide workflows, safeguards, and quality standards for documentation generated or maintained with AI agents. Work directly with teams across ClickHouse to understand their needs, translate them into practical documentation processes, coach authors, and resolve competing priorities. Ensure documentation remains accurate, comprehensive, discoverable, and aligned with the pace of product development. Make documentation a driver of product adoption and growth, helping users discover ClickHouse, get started quickly, and convert into active users through an intuitive, frictionless documentation experience. What we’re looking for Prior experience managing and developing a technical team. A hands-on leader who is comfortable moving between people management, technical writing, software engineering, process design, and day-to-day execution. Strong technical writing skills and experience independently producing documentation for complex software products, including the ability to investigate functionality, read and understand source code, validate product behavior, and translate findings into clear, accurate documentation for developers. Experience building, maintaining, and operating production websites, with a strong understanding of reliability, availability, performance, monitoring, and operational best practices. Strong experience with documentation-as-code workflows and modern software-development practices. Comfort working with Astro, TypeScript/JavaScript, GitHub Actions, pull-request workflows, and CI pipelines. Experience designing or operating content quality systems, automation, and contributor workflows at scale. Experience working productively with coding agents and a thoughtful point of view on applying AI to documentation without sacrificing accuracy, consistency, or trust. descriptionAr: ClickHouse is an open-source company building the fastest and most resource-efficient real-time data platform. Beyond the content, the Docs team owns the documentation infrastructure as a critical, production-facing service. Its availability, performance, and reliability directly affect our users' ability to work with ClickHouse. The team is responsible for building, operating, and continuously improving this experience. We're looking for a Documentation Engineering Manager to lead this work. Own the reliability, availability, performance, and technical evolution of the ClickHouse documentation website, treating it as a critical part of the product experience. Research, develop, and write technical documentation directly, including independently understanding product functionality through source code, experimentation, testing, and collaboration with Engineering and Product, rather than relying on others to provide initial drafts. Define and execute documentation strategy in partnership with Engineering, Product, Product Marketing, Learning, Support, Growth, and the open-source community. This role is hands-on at the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. descriptionAr: About the team OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this. In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible. About the role Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy. You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI. This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. In this role, you'll: Manage a number of key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan. Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to successful deployment. Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects. Own a consumption revenue target. Manage consumption revenue forecasts. Analyse key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders. Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies. Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering. Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates. Support the development of company culture. We're seeking someone with experience including: 10+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service. Have full professional fluency in both French and English. Achieving revenue targets >$2M per year for more than 3 years. Designing and executing complex deal strategies. Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies. Working directly with c-level executives. Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders. Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.). Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor. Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future. Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision. Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Dubai, UAE About the role The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a critical sales role responsible for driving high-volume, high-velocity net new business acquisition sales in a remote selling model within the commercial segment across EMEA, specifically META. Operating as full-cycle territory owners similar to an AE, ISR manages the end-to-end sales process from self-sourcing pipeline, qualifying opportunities and closing deals in partnership with SE and Partner Organisation What you'll do Build your own pipeline: Find new business across your assigned territory (META) through high-volume outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn and social selling, using tools like Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and AI outreach Run the whole sales cycle remotely: Lead discovery and qualification calls using MEDDPIC, give engaging virtual presentations and live product demos, and negotiate and close new business against an ACV quota. Explain the value of Cloudflare's platform: Connect commercial-segment customers' business and technical problems to the right Cloudflare products, such as Application Security and Performance, Zero Trust/SASE and the Developer Platform, and show the value they'd get. Work closely with other teams: Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical validation, and with the Partner Organisation to co-sell and close deals faster. Work with Marketing and BDR teammates on campaigns and events that create pipeline. Run your territory with data: Keep your Salesforce pipeline accurate and your forecasts reliable, track your activity and conversion numbers, and use what you learn to consistently meet or exceed your targets Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience: 1 - 3 years of experience in a sales role, preferably in SaaS or tech sales, such as:  BDR/SDR background with strong outbound experience in a high-paced environment SMB or Transactional sales experience with high volume, high velocity sales motion Strong track record of meeting or exceeding quota  Strong discovery and qualification skills using frameworks like BANT, MEDDIC  Excellent presentation and interpersonal communication skills (verbal and written) as well as time management skill Experience using CRM like Salesforce, outbound/prospecting sales tools (e.g. LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesforce Sales Engagement Outreach etc) Tech-savvy and technically curious - quick to learn technical products, comfortable to run live demos independently, data-driven mindset   Highly accountable and self-driven, customer-centric individuals Multilingual abilities (depending on the coverage regions) What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! We act as trusted technical advisors, working across customer strategy, architecture, deployment, and adoption to help organizations realize meaningful impact from frontier AI. The Startups segment serves fast-moving, high-growth companies that are often building new products, workflows, and businesses directly on top of AI. These customers move quickly, operate with high ambiguity, and expect practical, creative, and technically rigorous partnership. About the Role We are looking for an Applied AI Engineering Manager, Startups to lead and scale the Startups Applied AI Engineering motion. This team helps high-growth startups move quickly from experimentation to production, unlock meaningful usage, and build durable technical partnerships with OpenAI. This leader will operate in a high-velocity customer segment where founders, CTOs, and technical teams expect speed, judgment, and hands-on problem-solving. They will balance team leadership, technical depth, customer prioritization, and cross-functional influence across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and broader go-to-market teams. In this role, you will define how OpenAI supports startup customers at scale: identifying where deep technical engagement can unlock outsized impact, building repeatable deployment mechanisms, and ensuring the team can serve a broad and dynamic customer base without losing quality or strategic focus. In this role, you will: Craft and continuously refine the strategic vision and operating model for the Startups Applied AI Engineering team, aligning it with OpenAI’s broader company objectives and the evolving needs of high-growth startup customers. Lead, mentor, and grow a team of high-performing technical ICs supporting startup customers across AI-native, developer-led, and product-led companies. Help startups move from early experimentation to production usage by identifying technical blockers, advising on architecture, and driving practical paths to deployment. Partner closely with Sales to determine where technical engagement can accelerate adoption, production usage, and long-term account growth. Represent the technical voice of startup customers by synthesizing high-signal feedback, especially around developer experience, product gaps, deployment blockers, model performance, and emerging use cases. Translate recurring startup needs into repeatable playbooks, starter packs, reference architectures, internal tooling, and customer-facing assets that help the broader team move faster. Serve as a senior technical escalation point for priority startup customers, including founder-, CTO-, and technical executive-level conversations. Balance urgent customer needs with OpenAI’s broader product and platform priorities, especially when startups request niche features, bespoke support, or accelerated roadmap changes. Coach Applied AI Engineers on technical quality, customer judgment, prioritization, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership. Partner across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and other GTM teams to improve how OpenAI supports startups from early adoption through scaled production usage. You might thrive in this role if you: Have proven experience founding, scaling, or operating within early-stage startups, ideally in technical leadership roles where you owned both product or customer outcomes and technical execution. Have a strong track record of building and leading technical, customer-facing teams in high-growth, ambiguous, or startup-heavy environments. Bring strong technical depth across APIs, platform products, AI/ML systems, developer workflows, and production deployment considerations. Have experience creating scalable operating models, not just managing one-off customer escalations. Are comfortable working directly with founders, CTOs, technical executives, and highly technical ICs. Demonstrate strong judgment about when to go deep for a strategic customer versus when to build repeatable mechanisms for the broader segment. Can translate complex technical and product considerations into clear decisions, practical guidance, and customer-facing recommendations. Operate with speed, iteration, and pragmatic customer impact without sacrificing quality, safety, or OpenAI’s long-term platform strategy. Are personally committed to fostering the safe and beneficial development of AI. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s Enterprise Go-To-Market organization helps the world’s largest companies adopt and scale our AI platform across their business, from ChatGPT Enterprise to our developer and APIs. We partner with organizations across Financial Services, Life Sciences, and Retail to build new AI-powered customer experiences, transform operations, and reimagine how work gets done in highly regulated and technically complex environments. As adoption accelerates through pilots, experimentation, and develop-led use cases, the GTM team turns that momentum into durable, enterprise-wide deployments. About the Role This role is designed as a launchpad for future sellers at OpenAI. This is a highly strategic role with significant exposure to enterprise sales, product, and customer strategy. You’ll develop core skills in discovery, stakeholder mapping, deal shaping, and executive communication while building a deep understanding of how leading companies adopt AI. We are looking for individuals with 2-6+ years of professional experience who are motivated to grow into world-class enterprise sellers over time. While many individuals in this role go on to become Account Directors or take on broader GTM roles, progression is based on performance and business needs rather than a fixed timeline. For the right person, this is one of the most accelerated paths to break into sales at OpenAI and build a long-term career in AI go-to-market. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab.com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab.com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer. This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives. What you'll do Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion. Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them. Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage. Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD. Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services. Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback. Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers. Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence. Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. What you'll bring Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills. Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily. Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation. Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back. A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains. Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and stay transparent about progress and blockers. Experience with Cloudflare, Spanner, Argo CD, TypeScript, or operating GitLab at scale is a plus, not a requirement. About the team Every team in our organization owns its services end to end, from design through on-call.We own the control plane that tracks cells and decides where each request belongs, and keep the fleet in step with GitLab's release cadence.We work closely with delivery, database, migration, and product teams across GitLab. Feature teams own how their services behave on the platform; we own the underlying infrastructure.We're an all-remote, asynchronous team. We make decisions in GitLab issues, use directly responsible individuals (DRIs) to own technical direction, demo our work weekly, and use AI-assisted workflows every day. descriptionAr: Overview ClickHouse is seeking an experienced commercial lawyer to join ClickHouse’s elite and business-focused Legal team. You will be responsible for supporting ClickHouse’s EMEA sales team in reviewing and negotiating customer agreements and providing legal support for ClickHouse’s revenue-generating activities. You’ll be a trusted advisor and business enabler in a rapidly growing company while maintaining high standards for both legal practice and business ethics. What You’ll Do: Become an important member of the commercial legal team responsible for supporting the go-to-market team by reviewing and negotiating ClickHouse’s customer contracts. Your primary focus will be supporting the EMEA sales team. Cultivate strong relationships with the EMEA sales team and act as a solutions-oriented business partner to ClickHouse’s EMEA sales team by providing pragmatic, sound legal counsel. Negotiate complex cross-border transactions with sophisticated counterparties located across multiple jurisdictions, with increasing ownership of complex deals. Monitor and advise on relevant regulatory, compliance, or legal developments impacting the business in the EMEA region, and partner with the broader Legal team and cross-functional stakeholders where required. Provide training and enablement to internal stakeholders on legal issues and contract processes. Help maintain and update our legal agreements, policies, and templates; develop and improve scalable workflows to enable rapid revenue growth and stability for the company. As an early member of ClickHouse’s EMEA legal function, contribute to building the playbooks, templates, and processes the region will run on, with mentorship and support from the broader Legal team. What You Bring Along: Qualified lawyer in good standing in the UK or another European jurisdiction, with the right to work in the hiring location; local qualification (or active pursuit of it) a plus. 3-6 years of law firm and/or in-house experience. Experience supporting high growth infrastructure SaaS companies is a plus. Exceptional academic performance and training, including a law degree from a highly ranked university and/or experience at a top-tier law firm in the technology space. Proven experience drafting, negotiating, and closing complex commercial technology transactions and SaaS agreements with enterprise customers, partners, and resellers across multiple jurisdictions. International legal experience is a plus. Strong understanding of commercial legal issues related to SaaS and software licensing (i.e., data privacy, security, intellectual property, open-source, revenue recognition, and tax), professional services, and other go-to-market programs (such as partner/reseller programs). Excellent judgement, strong business orientation, and ability to translate legal risk into practical commercial advice within the context of business objectives. Strong interpersonal, communication, and management skills; ability to build trust and strong relationships with ClickHouse’s sales team, cross-functional stakeholders, and ClickHouse’s customers. Exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Experience with EU/UK data protection regulations in commercial negotiations and familiarity with regulated customer requirements (i.e., DORA) is a plus. Experience negotiating on customer paper and working with negotiation playbooks and fallback positions is a plus. Fluency in additional European languages is a plus. Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. Evaluate architectural and microarchitectural tradeoffs across bandwidth, latency, throughput, and resource utilization. Partner with design verification and formal verification teams to ensure functional correctness, develop verification strategies, and debug complex design issues. Enjoy working on ambiguous, technically challenging problems and taking ownership of designs from concept through integration. Bring experience with Network-on-Chip (NoC), networking, interconnect fabrics, packet-based architectures, or high-bandwidth data movement systems. descriptionAr: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. About the role: We are looking for an Engineering Manager, Security to lead the teams that secure our cloud, our infrastructure, and the code we ship. You will manage two closely linked groups: Cloud & Infrastructure Security : engineers who own cloud security posture, configuration hardening, and infrastructure vulnerability management across GCP, AWS, and Azure, plus containers, Kubernetes, and SaaS platforms. Application Security & Secure SDLC : engineers who run our SCA, SAST, and IaC scanning programs, drive remediation with engineering teams, and deliver secure development training. The core responsibility of this role is getting vulnerabilities fixed on time . You will partner with engineering teams across the company to drive remediation of cloud, infrastructure, and code findings within SLA, so that we consistently meet our compliance commitments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, and customer contracts). You will hire and grow a high-performing team, set the strategy and roadmap for vulnerability management from code to cloud, and make secure-by-default the easiest path for every developer. You will not run incident response yourself, but you need to understand it well enough to support the incident response team with context, prioritization, and follow-up fixes. What You'll Do: Team Leadership & Strategy Build, lead, and mentor a team of cloud security, infrastructure vulnerability management, and application security engineers; own hiring, career development, and performance management. Define the multi-year roadmap and quarterly OKRs for cloud security, vulnerability management, and Secure SDLC, balancing risk reduction against developer velocity. Set clear ownership, operating rhythms, and on-call/escalation processes across the team. Report on security posture, risk trends, and program metrics to engineering and executive leadership. Remediation & Compliance Delivery Own remediation SLAs by severity across cloud, infrastructure, container, and code findings, and make sure they map to our compliance obligations (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, customer contracts). Partner with engineering managers and tech leads to plan, prioritize, and land fixes within SLA without stalling roadmaps. Run a regular remediation review with engineering leadership: open findings, SLA burn-down, upcoming SLA breaches, and owners. Manage the exception and risk-acceptance process: documented justification, compensating controls, expiry dates, and approvals. Build automated workflows that route findings to the right owning team, track them to closure, and escalate before SLAs are breached. Work with Compliance/GRC to produce audit-ready evidence of remediation timeliness, and lead the security side of external audits for vulnerability management controls. Track and report metrics such as SLA attainment, mean time to remediate, backlog age, and exceptions, by team and severity. Cloud & Infrastructure Security Lead infrastructure vulnerability management across cloud workloads, containers, registries, data stores, and platform services, from scanning and contextual risk triage to remediation workflows. Oversee configuration hardening and secure baselines across GCP (primary) and supporting AWS and Azure environments. Own the strategy for Cloud, Kubernetes, and Data Security Posture Management (CSPM, KSPM, DSPM) tooling; make sure findings are accurate, prioritized, and actionable. Secure critical SaaS platforms with sound configurations, access controls, and integrations. Partner with Platform and ML Infrastructure teams to secure multi-tenant and AI infrastructure. Application Security & Code Scanning Own the SCA, SAST, and IaC scanning programs end to end: tool selection, CI/CD integration, rule tuning, noise reduction, and developer experience. Drive software supply chain security, including dependency management, SBOMs, artifact signing, and progress through SLSA levels. Feed code-scanning findings into the central remediation workflow so they reach the owning team automatically and are tracked against SLA. Shift IaC security left so misconfigurations are caught in pull requests, before they reach production. Secure SDLC & Developer Enablement Define and run the Secure SDLC program: security requirements, threat modeling, secure design reviews, and release gates proportionate to risk. Build and deliver security training, including onboarding, role-based secure coding training, and targeted sessions driven by real vulnerability trends. Develop paved roads, secure defaults, and guardrails that make the secure path the easiest path for engineers. Grow a Security Champions network across engineering teams. Incident Response Partnership & Collaboration Understand the incident response lifecycle well enough to support the IR team: supply asset, exposure, and vulnerability context, and help assess blast radius. Own follow-up remediation from incidents and postmortems that touch cloud, infrastructure, or code, and track it to closure. Feed incident learnings back into scanning rules, secure baselines, and developer training. Collaborate with Security Monitoring/Detection, Incident Response, Offensive Security, PSIRT, Architecture, DevOps, and Platform Engineering. Help communicate security advisories, best practices, and updates to customers. Tune into threat intelligence alerts to promptly manage patching of critical, exploitable vulnerabilities. Required Skills & Experience: 8+ years in security engineering, cloud security, or DevSecOps, including 2+ years managing security engineers (or 3+ years as a tech lead with formal people-leadership responsibility). Deep, hands-on knowledge of cloud security in GCP plus working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure

We bridge mainstream commerce rails with decentralized smart contract environments, enabling micropayments at Internet scale to keep the web payable . Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows. Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams. Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes. Interface directly with blockchain, wallet, and cryptography teams while scaling decentralized transaction pipelines on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects. Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow. Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability. Develop technic

descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. You will further be responsible for the development and implementation of consistent processes and tools for consistent and effective management of our infrastructure. This is a highly visible position that requires deep technical understanding of datacenter infrastructure, physical and logical network configuration, system administration, server provisioning and troubleshooting, and basic experience with data analysis and project management. Perform network configuration tasks to network devices in greenfield deployment and brownfield migration activities. Managing remote contractors to complete datacenter installations and upgrades (rack and stack), including coordinating with hardware manufacturers, datacenter and network providers, logistics partners and other service providers in support of our 700+ growing datacenter locations. Build automation to eliminate repetitive work using Python scripts and templated change management workflows (Python + Jinja-based) that standardize deployment steps. Our team also develops agentic AI tools to reduce admin overhead and handling other operational toil. Planning and implementing network and server installations, including in the areas of facility power (AC/DC), cooling, security/access, rack layout and cable management. Providing technical leadership and guidance to remote contractors and junior team members during deployment activities—walking them through configurations, troubleshooting steps, and quality checks. Creating and maintaining documentation, plans, SOPs, MOPs and runbooks. Collaborating with internal teams (Infrastructure Engineering and Planning, Network Engineering and SRE) on day-to-day operations and project planning. Coordinating installation of cross-connects globally in support of physical network expansion. Assisting with the definition, documentation and implementation of consistent processes and standardization across all regions. Limited travel. Required Experience Minimum of 5 years of prior relevant experience in Data Center Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, Linux Systems Administration, Network Engineering, and/or DevOps experience. Familiarity with day-to-day tasks and projects common in Data Center Operations. Experience with optical transport technologies such as CWDM/DWDM. Configuration management tool experience like Saltstack, Chef, Puppet or Ansible. Knowledge and exposure to Network Protocols, Topologies and Enterprise architecture.  Experience writing network configuration and design documentation. Experience with network and server installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. Experience with remote "lights-out" and out-of-band access to data center resources (IPMI/BMC for remote server administration). FIELD MARKETING MANAGER As our founding Field Marketer, you will be the primary growth engine and lead marketing architect for the Japan region, responsible for translating our global strategy into localized, high-impact programs to both land and expand in the largest enterprise accounts. We are looking for a high-energy, revenue-minded marketing strategist who can alternate between strategic pipeline and account planning with the Sales Team and flawless execution of experiences for customer executives. If you are obsessed with driving pipeline impact from high-touch, standout programs and are a self-starter that thrives at the intersection of technical innovation and enterprise GTM, we want you! RESPONSIBILITIES: Design the Regional Playbook: Build and execute a data-driven marketing plan tailored to your region's specific needs, focusing on the largest enterprise accounts Master the Land & Expand: Own the regional pipeline target. You will deploy a mix of high-touch events, executive roundtables, thought leadership roadshows, industry tradeshows, and account-based activations to identify and accelerate opportunities that ensure wall-to-wall adoption in our highest potential accounts Creative Agility: Fearlessly think outside the standard playbook to deploy memorable experiences across in person, virtual and next gen marketing formats as well as the operational workflows that bring them to life. Be ready and eager to break the mold and go big! Big Picture Operator: Be excited to bring the SpaceXSI mission and story to our customers by partnering with corporate marketing to ensure sharp messaging at every touchpoint Sales Partner: Act as the strategic marketing partner to Regional Sales Teams. You'll lead marketing planning calls, provide account-level insights, analyze regional pipeline trends, ensure absolute alignment on account priorities and maximize the adoption and impact of all marketing efforts Event Orchestration: Obsess over the end-to-end details of every program with total ownership, from ideation, to promotion, to vendor management, to onsite experience, and follow-up, going beyond just day-of execution Data-Driven Iteration: Track every dollar spent against pipeline generated. Manage your regional budget with a focus on high-impact investments Feedback Loop: Serve as the "eyes and ears" of the field. Provide the Corporate Marketing teams with real-time feedback, needs and ideas on messaging resonance and competitive shifts BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 5+ years of experience in Field or Revenue Marketing within B2B SaaS Fluency in both English and Japanese PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Understand the complexity of selling to the CTO, VP of Engineering, and CISO The Revenue Mindset: You don't care about "leads"; you care about pipeline and ARR. You speak the language of sales and aren't afraid to be held to a pipeline number The "Gritty" Optimizer: You are a self-starter who can build a program from a blank sheet of paper and then obsessively optimize it based on the data Whether it's writing a personalized invite to a CIO or presenting a quarterly business review (QBR) to leadership, your communication is sharp, professional, and persuasive ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Remote role (Japan)

About the Role As a Product Engagement Manager on the User Operations team, you will lead a team of Product Engagement Specialists responsible for ensuring smooth, successful product launches across internal and external teams. You’ll be the glue connecting product teams and support operations, equipping teams with the tools and knowledge needed to support new product rollouts. You’ll build scalable feedback loops that capture the voice of the user and translate insights into actionable product improvements, and ensure that frontline teams have the knowledge and skills to deliver accurate, delightful customer interactions at scale. We’re looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of product management, team enablement, and customer advocacy, and who enjoys working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, evolving environment. This person will manage the day-to-day work while also helping architect the systems needed to scale it. The successful candidate will be a leader-coach who can lead a small team while continuing to perform individual contributor work. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Lead a team coordinating product launches across internal and external teams, ensuring seamless execution and support readiness. Set the team’s strategy and priorities, translate them into clear goals and quality standards, and allocate capacity to deliver against them. Build a high-performing team through ongoing coaching, feedback, development, and performance management. Build out a Voice of the User program with scalable feedback loops between support, Product, and Engineering pre and post launch, so customer insights inform product development and strategy. Advocate for users by representing their needs and pain points in product and engineering discussions. Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations to align on launch goals and timelines. Monitor post-launch performance and gather support data to assess product impact and inform improvements. Document and standardize launch procedures to make them repeatable and scalable. Identify launch risks and propose solutions that minimize disruption to customers. Report on feedback-loop performance, including key insights, trends, and recommendations for the product roadmap. You might thrive in this role if you: Have experience leading product enablement or launch-readiness functions at scale, particularly in a customer support environment. Have shipped tooling or automations that reduced manual work and scaled beyond a single team (workflows, dashboards, scripted automation, lightweight pipelines)." Have experience in product management with automation and tool development, using metrics and feedback to improve decisions and processes. Build strong cross-functional relationships with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams. Are passionate about customer advocacy and can translate customer feedback into strategic product insights. Are highly organized and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines. Communicate technical concepts and customer pain points clearly to diverse audiences. Take ownership of initiatives from ideation through implementation and post-launch analysis. Thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. descriptionAr: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. HEAD OF APJ FIELD MARKETING As the Head of APJ Field Marketing, you are the chief marketing architect of our go-to-market engine across the Enterprise and Strategic teams. You will lead a high-performing team of Field Marketing Managers to design, execute, and optimize regional marketing strategies that drive pipeline and revenue. We are looking for a player-coach who is as comfortable interpreting a dashboard as they are commanding a room during a QBR. If you think business-first, are outcome-obsessed and thrive in high-growth, fast-paced environments, we want to talk. RESPONSIBILITIES: Architect the Theater Strategy: Develop comprehensive marketing plans across regions, segments, and industries to both land and expand in the largest enterprise accounts Deliver theatre growth plans: Build differentiated strategies, scalable programs, and world-class events across buying personas and industries, delivering at-scale and account-based tactics. You also won't be afraid to jump in and execute alongside your team! Galvanize Sales Partnerships: Act as a trusted strategic advisor to Sales and Inside Sales Leadership through compelling executive presentations, insights-driven recommendations, and business reviews Outcome Optimization: Track lead flow from initial touchpoint to closed-won revenue. Partner with Sales Ops to refine conversion metrics and maximize ROI Lead a Remote Fleet: Manage and mentor a geographically dispersed team. You'll be responsible for hiring, onboarding, and fostering a culture of high performance and continuous learning Drive cultural excellence: Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, data-driven decision-making, and collaborative execution across geographically distributed teams Develop future leaders: Own talent strategy including succession planning, career pathing, and leadership development to build bench strength for sustained growth Cross-Functional Advocacy: Serve as the "voice of the theater" back to Corporate Marketing to ensure regional needs are met and global initiatives are successfully localized Establish executive-level reporting: Build comprehensive dashboards and KPI frameworks that track pipeline, program ROI, and business impact Drive data-informed strategy: Leverage analytics to identify growth opportunities, optimize resource allocation, measure program effectiveness, and demonstrate marketing's contribution to revenue Continuously optimize: Develop feedback loops and refinement processes that improve investment efficiency and program performance Budget Ownership: Manage the APAC roll-up budget, ensuring every dollar is allocated toward high-impact activities BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 10+ years of progressive leadership experience building and scaling marketing teams PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Proven people leader with a track record of building, scaling, and inspiring high-performing marketing teams Coaching excellence: Demonstrated ability to develop talent, drive career growth, and create environments where top performers thrive Change management prowess: Ability to lead organizational transformation, drive adoption of new processes, and navigate ambiguity in fast-paced, high-growth environments The Data Storyteller: You don't just report numbers; you provide insights. You are fluent in the metrics that drive the business The Communicator: Exceptional presentation skills. You can build trust with C-suite executives and external partners alike ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Ability to travel as needed to support theater events and team meetings
